ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: In the figure, the quadrilateral $ABCD$ is inscribed in circle $\odot O$, $\angle ADC=60^\circ$, and the radius of $\odot O$ is $3\,cm$. What is the length of the chord $AC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Draw $OA$ and $OC$, and construct $OE \perp AC$ at $E$,\\
since $\angle ADC=60^\circ$,\\
thus $\angle AOC=2\angle ADC=120^\circ$,\\
since $OA=OC$,\\
thus $\angle AOE=\angle COE=60^\circ$, $AC=2AE$,\\
thus $\sin\angle AOE=\frac{AE}{AO}$,\\
thus $AE=AO\cdot \sin\angle AOE$,\\
thus $AE=3\sin60^\circ=\frac{3\sqrt{3}}{2}$,\\
thus $AC=2AE=\boxed{3\sqrt{3}}$,
